0022600164.text: The Sacramento Kings (0-6, on a six-game losing streak) visit the Dallas Mavericks (4-2, winners of three straight) in the Kings' seventh game of the season. Sacramento is missing Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf strain), Keegan Murray (ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee), and Zach LaVine is day-to-day with elbow soreness. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel inflammation), and Kyrie Irving is day-to-day with a knee issue. The 2026-27 season series has no games yet, while the Kings won the 2025-26 series 2-1, most recently beating the Mavericks 130-121 in Dallas on February 26, 2026.
